descriptionChirho: A person who conjures the dead or the spirit associated with divination and necromancy, consistently forbidden in Mosaic law (Lev 19:31, 20:6, 20:27; Deut 18:11; 1 Sam 28:3,7,8,9; 2 Kgs 21:6, 23:24; Isa 8:19, 19:3, 29:4; 1 Chr 10:13).
A container made of animal skin used to hold wine or other liquids, used as a simile for pressure building up inside (Job 32:19).
